steps.title: Audit feed endpoints
steps.note: The audit feed exposes POST /api/v1/admin/audit to write events and GET /api/v1/admin/audit to list them. Both endpoints require organization owner or admin role.

steps.title: Event schema
steps.note: Every event records actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, metadata, and timestamp. This schema maps directly to Cowork approval gate results and workspace lifecycle hooks.

steps.title: Cursor pagination
steps.note: Events are ordered by created_at ASC, id ASC with a cursor of created_at|id. The cap is 100 events per page, which matters when streaming high-volume tool approval logs.
